items.title: English Conversation Club
items.summary: Looking to improve your English in a friendly, informal setting? Our English Conversation Club for adults (18+) is a peer-led group where we practice English through weekly themed activities – from discussing food and money to exploring culture and travel. Strengthen your speaking, reading, and writing skills while meeting new people!
